metadata.title: नेचुरल रंगों से कैसे रंगते हैं साड़ियाँ । Natural Colour Dyeing of Saree । Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Mayurbhanj district of Odisha is famous for its handloom weaves, and natural colours that are used to dye them.
However, dyeing with natural colours is rare these days, with powerlooms having taken over the weaving industry. In fact, the entire handloom industry here is gasping for air, as it searches for a favourable ecosystem.

But there is a ray of hope as some people are trying to revive the art, by training local women in the art of dyeing with natural colours.

For updates regarding upcoming videos and stories, follow our social media accounts linked below::
